title: Why Doesn't Askeladd Want to Become King? Vinland Saga Explained
seoTitle: Why Askeladd Doesn't Want to Be King in Vinland Saga
seoDescription: Why Askeladd never takes a throne in Vinland Saga: his real background, his goal of protecting Wales, his hatred of Danes and why he backs Canute.
excerpt: Askeladd's real backstory (a Danish chieftain father and an enslaved Welsh mother), his secret goal for Wales, why he backs Canute instead of taking a throne, and what his final act at Sweyn's court means.
